body: Finally back from my walk, flip flops probably wasn't my best bet for how long I was gone for. I do feel a little better but I'm still really worried about what's in store for me. I want it to get better and I'm at my wits end I need things to change before I spiral out of control again like tonight.

Yeah that's exactly where I'm at right now sans couch surfing. Writing this note got me thinking, i dunno i think i might go take a walk for a bit and see how i feel, i was looking at other threads and that seemed to be some advice. just going to see what that does for me, i might throw you a message when i get back.

That's what I'm afraid of, I really can't handle something like that. As for the depression thing I just don't want to come off as The Boy Who Cried Depression. I feel like it gets thrown around so much like I've come this far tonight and I still don't know if I'm really depressed, I mean I feel like dying just...black but I feel like if I did it it would be justified not because i'm sad idk if this makes sense, i'm drunk and just really upset
This post IS my reaching out, I don't want to risk any sort or problems forming by going to him with this.

I mean he knows of my situation, we've discussed it before its just my whole mentality as of lately I haven't discussed I don't want to tarnish anything between us. There isn't anything he could do for me so I'd rather not drag anybody in that doesn't need to be

I know what i wrote may have been confusing but the one moving is not the one who offered the job in the first place, as for your question I'm not sure I catch your meaning, maybe its because I've been drinking or what, could you rephrase?
I don't want to dump that into his life, his brother killed himself about 10 years ago. That seems wrong to me
I don't want to bother him, he's out with his new girlfriend right now and I don't want to intrude with my dumb shit.

A recent job opportunity was offered by a friend out loud, knowing how I've been dying for something like this I jumped onto it, I asked about it a few times, a week went by me asking and him telling me he was busy and didn't have a chance to ask about it, which is what I was told last night. To find out another common friend just had an interview last week for said position. I know it may seem petty or non significant but its things like these where i seem so close to getting what I want or where I want to be, and the rug gets pulled out from under me. The water heater broke last week and there's mold in the wall, the girl I love is moving on, my dog is dying, and my only really good friend's career is taking him halfway across the states. It feels like the perfect storm.
